flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmseserviceui route/route.ts (furnish-particulars); ocmseserviceapi workflows/furnish/{FurnishApplicationListController,FurnishApplicationListServiceImpl,FurnishValidationServiceImpl,FurnishSubmissionController,FurnishSubmissionServiceImpl}, crud/beans/SystemConstant (Furnish.ELIGIBLE_STAGES), crud/ocmspii/eocmsoffencenoticeownerdriver; ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/furnish_processing/{services/FurnishProcessingService,helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper}, schedulers/SyncInternetIntranetJobsScheduler, crud/beans/SystemConstant (FurnishStage), Toppan upload/download for the follow-up stages. ocmsadminapi FurnishabilityChecker (staff path) is only a comparison; ocmsadminui and thirdpartyapi are not used
note: Status in stories.json: 'Requirement given - Gen flow' (3 points); demo_remark: 'Internet PII encryption - cannot fetch offender particulars'. There is no flow deck, so Sesuai means the code follows the story text. The core flow exists end to end: the owner furnishes through the eService at stages ROV/ENA/RD1/RD2, a Pending application is stored in the PII DB, a cron every 10 minutes (enabled in prod) checks and auto-approves, the hirer or driver becomes the current offender, then the stage is reset to RD1 (hirer) or DN1 (driver). Gaps: (1) fetching offender data from the encrypted PII DB failed in the demo, which cannot be proven from the repo; (2) Appendix B Annex 1A is not in the repo, so the match of the stage list and reminder order with Appendix B cannot verify from repo, and the repo holds three different furnishable-stage lists; (3) the follow-up after the reset depends on the Toppan letters (generation cron off, SFTP upload blocked by config, OCMS-DF-2026-192 Ready to UAT) and on the eNotification whose cron is off; (4) from reading the code, the letter_address reset after the first letter does not know furnished_mail (to be verified). The story text is almost the same as OCMS11.26 and equal steps got equal fits. Tickets used as hints: OCMS-DF-2026-067, OCMS-DF-2026-077, OCMS-DF-2026-110, OCMS-DF-2026-143, OCMS-DF-2026-137, OCMS-DF-2026-170, OCMS-DF-2026-192. Singpass/Corppass, Azure property values and the PII DB content: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. The furnish flow from the owner up to the stage reset to the hirer or driver exists and works; not proven is the follow-up of letters and notifications after it (generation cron off, Toppan upload blocked, eNotification off) and the match with Appendix B Annex 1A. Ask URA for Appendix B and confirmation of the prod config.

steps.step: The vehicle owner logs in to the Online Customer Portal and sees the list of their NOPOs that can be furnished
steps.detail: After login (JWT), POST v1/furnishapplicationlist without a status calls getEligibleNotices: it loads the notices of the owner ID (offender_indicator Y), drops notices that already have a Pending application, and marks a notice 'Eligible' when isNoticeEligibleForFurnish passes (FurnishApplicationListServiceImpl.java:78-150). The ID lookup uses the encrypted column through DecryptByKey (EocmsOffenceNoticeOwnerDriverRepository.java:23). The UI page is on route furnish-particulars (route.ts:38-40). Sebagian because the story demo_remark says 'Internet PII encryption - cannot fetch offender particulars': whether the encryption key and PII DB access work in the environment cannot verify from repo. The Singpass/Corppass handshake cannot verify from repo. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-067 and OCMS-DF-2026-077 (Closed, Prod deployed): furnishable notices were not shown because is_sync was not set to N; fixed.

steps.step: Only NOPOs at the pre-defined stages (e.g. 1st reminder RD1 and 2nd reminder RD2) that are not suspended can be furnished
steps.detail: ELIGIBLE_STAGES = ROV, ENA, RD1, RD2 (SystemConstant.java:112-113). isProcessingStageEligible checks last_processing_stage, with a fallback to next_processing_stage only for RD1/RD2 (FurnishValidationServiceImpl.java:175-183). getIneligibilityReason also rejects notices with crs_reason_of_suspension set, PS with reason DIP/MID/FOR/RIP/RP2, and type U (UPL) notices (FurnishValidationServiceImpl.java:186-216). Matches the 1st/2nd reminder examples in the story. The repo holds three different furnishable-stage lists (eService: ROV/ENA/RD1/RD2; approval cron: last|next pairs, SystemConstant.java:237-244 in ocmsadminprivateapi; staff API ocmsadminapi FurnishabilityChecker.java:51-62: NPA to CPC). Appendix B Annex 1A is not in the repo, so the match of the full list with Appendix B cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The owner fills in the hirer or driver particulars (name, ID, mailing address, phone, email, relationship to the owner) and the form validates them
steps.detail: POST v1/furnishapplication (FurnishSubmissionController.java:66) takes the owner identity from the JWT, not from the input, then validator.validateAll checks the required fields, ID, email, phone and documents (line 99). validateSelfFurnish blocks an owner from furnishing themself (FurnishValidationServiceImpl.java:51-91) and validateQAResponses blocks a driver without hirer details and a hirer without driver details (102-141); both are called from the controller (108-132). Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-110 and OCMS-DF-2026-143 (Closed, Prod deployed): submit failed with 'Error occurred during submission' for some owners, closed; OCMS-DF-2026-137 fixed the UEN validation and does not change the verdict.

steps.step: The submitted particulars are saved as a furnish application with status Pending together with the supporting documents
steps.detail: Each notice is validated first (validateAllNoticesForSubmission, FurnishSubmissionController.java:138; fail-all): the notice must be eligible, the user must be the offender and not the Driver, and no Pending application may exist. mapToEntity fills the owner data, the hirer/driver data, owner_driver_indicator, status Pending and is_sync N (FurnishSubmissionServiceImpl.java:157-211), then saveAll writes to the PII DB and the documents are moved to permanent storage (94-127).

steps.step: A cron pulls the applications into the intranet and auto-approves them when they pass the checks; the rest go to manual review
steps.detail: The SyncInternetIntranet scheduler runs every 10 minutes and is enabled in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:305-306); its first job is Furnish Processing (SyncInternetIntranetJobsScheduler.java:67). processSingleSubmission runs 6 checks: active PS, HST ID, FIN/Passport, furnishable stage (last|next pair), existing offender, and prior submission (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:183-226, 322-333). Pass means executeApproval, fail means executeManualReview (FurnishProcessingService.java:158-175). The staff manual review belongs to the OCMS41 stories and is not rated here.

steps.step: After approval the hirer or driver is recorded as the current offender, replacing the previous one
steps.detail: executeApproval calls addFurnishedOffender (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:445-458). switchOffenderIndicator changes the old offender_indicator from Y to N in the intranet and internet DBs (713-745), then a new owner_driver record is created with role H or D, offender_indicator Y, and the name, ID, email and phone from the furnish application (542-558). processFurnishedAddress sets letter_address null on the old offender address and stores the furnished_mail address with letter_address Y (593-636). The staff-side furnish (ocmsadminapi) is the topic of OCMS-DF-2026-024 and is not rated here.

steps.step: The NOPO stage is reset so the follow-up is directed at the hirer (RD1) or the driver (DN1)
steps.detail: changeProcessingStage: role H becomes stage RD1, role D becomes DN1; the old stage is kept in prev_processing_stage; last and next processing stage are set to the new stage; next_processing_date is recalculated; administration_fee is reset to 0 and amount_payable is set to composition_amount (fix of OCMS-DF-2026-170, Closed); then the eVON is synced (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:643-711). The NOPO therefore no longer runs under the owner. The stage rules compared with Appendix B Annex 1A: cannot verify from repo (the document is not in the repo).

steps.step: The next automated reminder processing workflow (letters and notifications per Appendix B) runs against the hirer or driver
steps.detail: The stage chain exists: ToppanStage RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3 (ToppanStage.java:19-26). Sebagian because: (1) Appendix B Annex 1A is not in the repo, so the order, duration and action per stage against Appendix B cannot verify from repo; (2) letter generation by the 00:15 cron is switched off (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118 is commented out), letters only run through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34); (3) sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (application-prod.properties:86) means the letter file does not reach Toppan (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:206-209), yet the stage still advances through the delivery gate bypass (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-446), see OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT); (4) the daily eNotification is off (cron.notification.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:236); (5) to be verified, from reading the code: resetLetterAddressAfterToppan only picks mha_reg, lta_reg, lta_mail (ToppanUploadHelper.java:467-468), not furnished_mail, so a hirer or driver with only a furnished_mail address may lose letter_address Y after the first letter; not proven by a run. The real server property values cannot verify from repo.
